name: CutCraft v1.1.1 (Subtitles, Captions, Title Cards & Ripple Edit Release)
releaseNotes:
CutCraft v1.1.1 Release Update:
- Subtitles & Captions engine: dual SubRip (.srt) and WebVTT (.vtt) support with split, merge, and time shifting
- Automated Subtitle QA validation: reading speed warnings, cue overlap checks, and invalid timestamp detection
- Stylized Animated Title Cards: 6 templates (Lower Third, Cinematic Header, Bold Headline, Minimalist, Neon Glow, Vintage Retro) with Fade, Slide, and Zoom motion typography
- Timeline Ripple Edit & Gap Closing engine: Ripple Delete (Shift+Delete), In/Out ripple trimming, Close Gap (Alt+G), Auto-Pack all clips, and non-destructive Ripple Insert
- Accessible screen reader announcements and audio cues for all subtitle, overlay, and ripple editing operations
- Comprehensive auto-updater with SHA-256 verification and seamless background update checks
